name: Sedna
description: Work in your teams' shared email in Sedna: read, draft and send, tag, link job references, assign, attachments and contacts.

info.capabilities: Reads your own Sedna teams' messages; drafts and sends as you, tags, links job references and assigns, asking first where it reaches people
info.availability: An owner or admin enters the home's Sedna API credentials

credentials.help: An admin of your Sedna organisation makes these on Sedna's API Credential Management page: in Sedna, Settings, then API Credential Management. Give the credential these permissions to read: COMPANY_READ, USER_READ, TEAM_READ, MESSAGE_READ, EVENT_READ, CATEGORYTAG_READ, JOBREFERENCE_READ, COMMENT_READ, DOCUMENT_READ, TEMPLATE_READ and CONTACT_READ; and to change things: MESSAGE_WRITE, MESSAGE_DELETE, JOBREFERENCE_WRITE and CONTACT_WRITE. For reading only, the first ones are enough. If another program already reaches your Sedna's API with a username and password (Basic auth), that pair is one of these credentials: its username is the client ID and its password the client secret. If the page isn't there, your Sedna plan may not include the API: ask Sedna's support.
